title: RuscaLinux 1.99.1
content: RuscaLinux is a desktop Linux distribution based on Debian's "Stable" branch and featuring the GNOME desktop. The project's goal is to provide a complete, ready-to-go desktop with a curated software set, but without any update mechanisms. This is the distribution's deliberate design choice; it provides no live repositories so the system stays exactly as installed and tested, and any new versions arrive as fresh ISO images. It is a stability-first model, similar in spirit to immutable distributions but reached through a different path.
